records.source: 極龍の力の象徴である磁力を{j}応用した片手剣。龍と睡眠の{j}双属性で、畏れを薙ぎ払え！
records.previous: A Sword & Shield that applies the magnetism{j}symbolizing the Extreme Dragon's power. With its dual Dragon and Sleep{j}attributes, mow down all fear!
records.target: Sword & Shield using Extreme Dragon power.{j}Dragon and Sleep elements let{j}you mow down fear!

records.source: 甲殻種素材の堅さと鋭さを{j}可能な限り活かした片手剣。{j}職人の優れた研磨の技も秀逸。
records.previous: A Sword & Shield that exploits the hardness and sharpness of Carapaceon materials{j}to the fullest.{j}The craftsman's superb polishing is also outstanding.
records.target: Sword & Shield using Carapaceon materials{j}to maximize hardness and sharpness.{j}Polished by a master craftsman.

records.source: 鎌蟹の爪が持つ鋭さを{j}再現した双剣。二刀六刃の{j}角度まで探究されている。
records.previous: These Dual Blades reproduce the sharpness of the Shogun Ceanataur's claws.{j}Even the angles of the two blades and six edges{j}have been thoroughly investigated.
records.target: Dual Blades recreating Shogun Ceanataur{j}claw sharpness. Their twin blades and six{j}edges were precisely researched.

records.source: 呑龍の伸縮性による衝撃緩和と{j}優れた保湿性による耐熱効果に{j}より強力な一撃を放つ。
records.previous: Cushions impacts through the Glutton Dragon's elasticity, and{j}its superb moisture retention grants heat resistance,{j}letting it unleash an even more powerful blow.
records.target: Glutton Dragon elasticity cushions blows.{j}Moisture retention grants heat resistance,{j}unleashing a stronger blow.

records.source: 尾晶蠍の麻痺性と高い耐熱性{j}により、撃って良し、殴って{j}良しの強力な武器となった。
records.previous: Thanks to the Crystal-Tailed Scorpion's paralysis and high heat resistance{j}, it became a powerful weapon that is good for shooting and{j}good for striking.
records.target: Crystal-Tailed Scorpion paralysis and heat{j}resistance make this weapon powerful for{j}both shooting and striking.

records.source: 言い伝えられている昔話。男{j}女の名を冠した星々が重なる{j}時の煌きを音に込めた狩猟笛。
records.previous: A legend passed down through the ages. A{j}Hunting Horn that sets to sound the brilliance{j}of the moment when stars bearing a man's and woman's names align.
records.target: A Hunting Horn sounding a legend of stars.{j}It captures the glow when stars bearing a{j}man's and woman's names align.

records.source: 古の装飾が施された黒い片手{j}剣。儀礼用であったものを鍛{j}え、至高の逸品へと昇華した。
records.previous: A black Sword{j}& Shield adorned with ancient ornamentation. Forged{j}from what was once ceremonial, it was elevated into a supreme masterpiece.
records.target: Black Sword & Shield, ancient ornament.{j}Forged from a ceremonial weapon into{j}a supreme masterpiece.

records.source: 古の装飾が施された黒い狩猟{j}笛。儀礼用であったものを鍛{j}え、至高の逸品へと昇華した。
records.previous: A black Hunting{j}Horn adorned with ancient ornamentation. Forged{j}from what was once ceremonial, it was elevated into a supreme masterpiece.
records.target: Black Hunting Horn with ancient ornament.{j}Forged from a ceremonial weapon into{j}a supreme masterpiece.

records.source: 雷極龍を素材とし、その力を{j}宿した穿龍棍。龍の爪と角を{j}思わせる棍が敵を屠る。
records.previous: Using the Thunder Extreme Dragon as material, its power{j}A Tonfa imbued with the claws and horns of a dragon.{j}A staff that makes you think slays the enemy.
records.target: Tonfa made with Thunder Extreme Dragon{j}power, its claws and horns evoking a{j}dragon as it fells enemies.

records.source: 鍛錬を重ね、さらなる進化を{j}遂げた大剣。宿す光は輝きを{j}増し、その力は王者の風格。
records.previous: A Great Sword that has{j}achieved further evolution through repeated forging. The light it houses increases{j}its brilliance, and its power has the dignity of a king.
records.target: Great Sword refined through long training.{j}Its stored light shines brighter, with the{j}bearing of a king.
